distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Yunnan, including Xishuangbanna. Smith et al. (2022) records Guangxi and Yunnan and adds locality evidence from Guangxi, Shiwandashan.

host_note: No host is reported in the integrated Smith et al. (2020) record. Smith et al. (2022) reports Chrysophyllum (Sapotaceae), Cinnamomum (Lauraceae), Fagaceae, and Camellia sinensis (Theaceae); these records are promoted at their published taxonomic resolution.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Microperus chrysophylli (Eggers, 1930).
